challenges.challenge: Is folder membership read from smart_file_placements (placed-on), never reconstructed from entityId?
challenges.resolution: PASS. smartFileServe.listFilesInFolder joins placements WHERE target_type='folder' AND target_id=folderId. MCP list_smart_file_folder_files takes opaque folderId.

challenges.challenge: Are folders twin nodes, or a new registry?
challenges.resolution: FINDING. Migration 0081 creates smart_file_folders (folder:jurisdiction:48021:planning) plus smart_file_folder_records with a JSON payload sidecar. That is not ADR-010 edges onto live twin nodes, and the payload table is a second fact store. Accepted for Layer 1.5 seed-only so the panel has a folder tree and a record pane without atoms --apply. Do not freeze this as the graph. Do not promote folder_id as identity. A later row must replace the sidecar with real atom reads + applies-to/placed-on.
PASS on name search. Tools consume wire JSON via smartFilesClient. Promotion still planner-owned.

challenges.challenge: Will ci-gate-map-vs-server-tool see tools registered outside tools.ts?
challenges.resolution: FAIL. registerSmartFilesTools lives in smart-files-tools.ts. The gate greps only src/tools.ts. Four REPORTING_TOOLS names are stale vs that grep. Must expand the scan to src/**/*.ts (or register in tools.ts). Caught in CI, not in CP1.
